data.name: Title
data.comment: Heading of the plant dictionary page, the name of its row in Settings and Search, and the title of its link on a plant's page.

data.name: BackToSettings
data.comment: Back link on the plant dictionary page.

data.name: Intro
data.value: Every genus and species of the groups below, with where they grow wild.
data.comment: One line under the heading of the plant dictionary page.

data.name: SearchPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder of the search box on the plant dictionary page.

data.name: GroupsHeading
data.comment: Heading over the groups of plants on the plant dictionary page.

data.name: FamiliesHeading
data.comment: Heading over the list of plant families on the plant dictionary page.

data.name: GroupAroids
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary: the arum family, like Monstera and Philodendron.

data.name: GroupPrayerPlants
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary: the Marantaceae, like Calathea and Maranta.

data.name: GroupBegonias
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary.

data.name: GroupCarnivorous
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary: pitcher plants, sundews and the like.

data.name: GroupCacti
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary.

data.name: GroupSucculents
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary.

data.name: GroupOrchids
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary.

data.name: GroupBromeliads
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary.

data.name: GroupOther
data.comment: Name of a group in the plant dictionary: everything that is not in the other groups.

data.name: Genus_One
data.comment: Count of genera, like 1 genus. {0} is the number.

data.name: Genus_Other
data.comment: Count of genera, like 316 genera. {0} is the number.

data.name: Species_One
data.comment: Count of species, like 1 species. The word is the same in the plural in English. {0} is the number.

data.name: Species_Other
data.comment: Count of species, like 4,120 species. {0} is the number.

data.name: Cultivar_One
data.comment: Count of cultivars, like 1 cultivar. {0} is the number.

data.name: Cultivar_Other
data.comment: Count of cultivars, like 8 cultivars. {0} is the number.

data.name: CountsLine
data.comment: How many genera and species a group or family has, like 316 genera · 4,120 species. {0} is the genera, {1} the species.

data.name: YouHave
data.comment: On a row of the plant dictionary: how many plants and cuttings of it you have. {0} is the number.

data.name: YouHaveShort
data.comment: At the end of a line of counts on the plant dictionary, like 316 genera · you have 7. {0} is the number.

data.name: SearchNothing
data.comment: Shown when a search in the plant dictionary finds nothing. {0} is what was typed.

data.name: SearchClear
data.comment: Button under the nothing found text of the plant dictionary search.

data.name: CouldNotLoad
data.value: The plant dictionary couldn't be loaded. Try again when you're online.
data.comment: Shown on the plant dictionary pages when the names file couldn't be read, like offline before it was ever downloaded.

data.name: NotFound
data.value: The dictionary has no page for that name.
data.comment: Shown when the address of a dictionary page names a group, family, genus, species or cultivar that isn't in it.

data.name: BackToDictionary
data.comment: Button under the not found text on a plant dictionary page.

data.name: GroupEmpty
data.comment: Shown on a group page that has no genera.

data.name: PartOf
data.comment: Line under a family's name. {0} is a link with the name of its group, like Aroids.

data.name: OldGenus
data.value: {0} is an old name. It is now part of {1}.
data.comment: Note on the page of an old genus name. {0} is the old name, {1} a link with the genus it is part of now.

data.name: OldIsNow
data.comment: A line under Old names: an old name and what it is called now. Both are botanical names, {1} is a link.

data.name: OldNamesHeading
data.comment: Heading over the list of old names on a genus page.

data.name: FactFamily
data.comment: Label of the plant family in the facts of a dictionary page.

data.name: FactGuide
data.comment: Label in the facts of a genus page in the dictionary, before the link to the guide for the genus's plant group.

data.name: FactGroup
data.comment: Label of the group, like Aroids, in the facts of a dictionary page.

data.name: FactSpecies
data.comment: Label of the number of species in the facts of a genus page.

data.name: FactCultivars
data.comment: Label of the number of cultivars in the facts of a genus page.

data.name: FactGrowsWild
data.comment: Label of the areas where a species grows wild, in the facts of a species page.

data.name: FactAlsoKnownAs
data.comment: Label of the old names of a species, in the facts of a species page.

data.name: SpeciesHeading
data.comment: Heading over the species of a genus. {0} is how many.

data.name: CultivarsHeading
data.comment: Heading over the cultivars of a genus or species. {0} is how many.

data.name: FilterSpecies
data.comment: Placeholder of the filter box over the species of a genus.

data.name: FilterNothing
data.comment: Shown when the filter over a genus's species matches none. {0} is what was typed.

data.name: RangeShort
data.comment: Where a species grows wild on a row, cut short: the first two areas and how many more, like Brazil, Peru +3. {0} is the two areas, {1} the number left out.

data.name: AddAsPlant
data.comment: Button on a dictionary page that opens Add a plant with the names filled in.

data.name: AddToWishlist
data.comment: Button on a dictionary page that opens a new wish with the names filled in.

data.name: DockLabel
data.comment: Screen reader name of the two buttons on a dictionary page. {0} is the name of the plant.

data.name: YouHaveHeading
data.comment: Heading of the card on a dictionary page with the plants, cuttings and wishes you have of it.

data.name: OnWishlist
data.comment: Line under a wish in the You have card of a dictionary page.

data.name: SeeInDictionary
data.value: See it in the plant dictionary
data.comment: Link on a plant's or cutting's page to its page in the plant dictionary.

data.name: BrowseLink
data.comment: Link under the heading of the Collection page.

data.name: SettingsRowDetail
data.value: Browse every genus and species, and where they grow wild
data.comment: Line under the Plant dictionary row in Settings.

data.name: SearchRowDetail
data.comment: Line under the Plant dictionary row on the Search page.

data.name: SearchGroup
data.comment: Heading of the group of search results from the plant dictionary. A number follows it.
